learningObjectives: Choose an export target for API testing or service virtualization.
Inspect generated request and response test steps instead of assuming universal counts.

elements.text: API TestCases have request and response XTestStep types. Execution modifies and sends a request, then transfers response data to response Module Attributes. Inspect the generated structure and configure meaningful assertions; an observed response alone is not proof of correctness.
Independent guidance: avoid relying on a universal two-Modules/two-steps rule across every export mode and message type. Verify actual artifacts and references before execution.
API Scan offers API TestCase, OSV Scenario and XML/JSON Test Case exports. Select messages or containers including subordinate messages. Choose the target that matches the intended test.

Selecting an existing ComponentFolder exports into it without creating another. Otherwise a new ComponentFolder is created. Export to Component Folders mirrors the project-tree structure using multiple folders.

Standalone API Scan exports a separate subset with a chosen path and name. This differs from saving the API Scan project. Current documentation does not establish the former fixed default-folder name or exclusive Ctrl-versus-Shift shortcut claim.

Export disposable messages to a selected folder; inspect generated artifacts, references and expected assertions. Repeat with structured-folder export. Academy exercise files were not accessed; this is an independent verification task.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming identical artifacts for every export
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Applying a fixed count to every message and target.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Inspect generated request/response steps and Modules for the chosen export.

examPitfalls.title: Ignoring the destination
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Expecting a new folder even when a destination is selected.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: An existing selected ComponentFolder receives the objects; structured export creates multiple folders.

examPitfalls.title: Treating historical UI as current
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Memorizing unsupported default names or future deprecation predictions.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use documented current targets and inspect your installed version.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which generated XTestStep types are documented for API TestCases?
practiceQuiz.rationale: The documented structure separates sending and response processing.

optionExplanations.A: UI clicks do not describe API message steps.
optionExplanations.B: These are the documented API step types.
optionExplanations.C: Screenshots do not constitute API message steps.
optionExplanations.D: Renaming folders is not API execution.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What can be selected for export from API Scan?

options.text: Only one message at a time.
Messages or containers with their subordinate messages.

practiceQuiz.hint: Selection can include a project-tree container.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Export accepts individual messages and containers.

optionExplanations.A: Export is not limited to one message.
optionExplanations.C: Export does not require selecting a Commander execution result.
optionExplanations.D: Screenshots are not the message export input.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which export target creates service-virtualization scenarios?
practiceQuiz.rationale: OSV Scenario is the appropriate export target; verify its prerequisites separately.

optionExplanations.C: OSV is the service-virtualization scenario target.
optionExplanations.D: Payload saving is not scenario export.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An existing ComponentFolder is selected before the ordinary export. Where are exported objects placed?

options.text: Always in a second new folder.
In the selected ComponentFolder without creating a new one.
Only in a text payload file.

practiceQuiz.hint: An explicit destination changes default behavior.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The selected folder receives the exported objects.

optionExplanations.A: A new folder is not mandatory with this destination.
optionExplanations.B: This is the documented selected-folder behavior.
optionExplanations.C: Payload persistence is a different operation.
optionExplanations.D: Selection does not discard the export.
